description: Two columns + a frame with a background (vector fill) on the right with a short sidebar — tests BlockKind:'sidebar' and the reading order without weaving the sidebar into the main flow.

expected.note: Construction fact: 8 lines of the left column (x=72), 8 of the right (x=300), 3 lines of the sidebar (x=490, inside a filled rectangle x=480-600,y=590-690). A vector region 'fill' with that bbox must appear in InventoryResult.vectors. buildSemanticBlocks() should classify the sidebar block as 'sidebar' (overlap with a fill region + a multi-column layout), NOT as a third column in the reading order of the main text. totalItemCount=20 (not 19): pdf.js inserts an empty synthetic TextItem at a mid-stream font size change (Tf between Tj) — here 1 transition (10->9 before the sidebar), hence 19 lines + 1 empty = 20.
